description: Writes HexaCore agent roles as Claude Code subagents in .claude/agents/hexacore-<role>.md: dev (design, scaffold, implement), qa (run checks, fix failures, lessons) and e2e (end-to-end and UI checks against a running app). Each role gets only the tools it needs and follows a handoff protocol through record_handoff. The user starts one by asking for it (or in its own terminal pane), and Claude Code delegates to it on its own when a task matches. Files edited by hand are left alone unless overwrite is set. Reversible through rollback_changes.

agent.description: The agent role making this call (e.g. "dev", "qa", "e2e"), so its work is attributed to it. Defaults to HEXACORE_AGENT.

overwrite.description: Replace files that were edited by hand

serverName.description: Name HexaCore is registered under in the client (default hexacore-agent); it prefixes the MCP tool names

name: export_agents
title: Export the dev, qa and e2e agent roles
